des: Create a .mcp_server_settings.json file in the data directory; pick from the MCP services below or add your own.
Useful MCP services will keep being tested and added here; contributions are welcome.
Remember to delete the comment lines; the des property is only a note and is not parsed.
The des and link properties only describe the installation method and the original link; they are not required.
Three transport modes are currently supported: stdio (standard input/output), sse (Server-Sent Events), streamable-http (streaming HTTP).

streamable-http-mcp-server.des: Uses the Streamable HTTP transport, suited to production web deployments
